text:
Hana Mori: FYI sample-app started throwing schema validation noise in staging after we flipped to the new streaming fncall path. looks like validator runs on partial chunks.
Declan Wu: can you paste the log? streaming fragments usually cause JSON.parse errors.
Hana Mori: snippet: 
```
[data] '{"call": {"name": "annotate", "args": {"items": ['
[data] '"p1","p2"'
[data] ']}}'
validator: SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input
```
Hana Mori: SDK currently tries to parse each event in json mode. with the stream we receive fragments so the checker trips.
Priya Menon: we should add a small SDK helper to assemble a top-level JSON frame before running schema validation. call it `collectTopJsonFrame` or `jsonFrameAssembler`.
Omar Farouk: agreed. constraints: must detect balanced top-level object/array, handle escaped braces inside strings, and avoid unbounded buffering. default caps: maxBytes=160KB, maxWaitMs=300ms.
Declan Wu: also need a partial delivery mode: if we hit caps, emit a {partial:true, payload: "..."} style marker so apps can decide to fetch a non-streaming response or process NDJSON.
Priya Menon: parity note: node should expose an async iterable wrapper, python an async generator with identical semantics and naming. tests should include NDJSON tool outputs and newline-delimited fragments inside args.
Hana Mori: good to add an opt-in immediate-token callback so UI apps can render tokens incrementally while the helper assembles the full object for validation in background.
Omar Farouk: telemetry: record jsonframe_mode, jsonframe_bytes, jsonframe_delay_ms and a counter for partial_emits. helps tune defaults after rollout.
Declan Wu: infra caution: auth/retry path caused duplicate validation runs previously; ensure the validator is idempotent and dedupe validation events when request-retries occur.
Priya Menon: I'll prototype the TS helper with unit tests for edgecases (escaped quotes, multi-object streams, concatenated JSON) and add a sample-app snippet in onboarding. Omar will mirror the python implementation.
Hana Mori: dev-bot: create issue and link PRs?
dx-bot: created issue #9137 "sdk: streaming json-frame assembler + parity + telemetry" and assigned Hana/Priya/Omar
Hana Mori: thanks. plan: land behind feature flag, run sample-app integration tests, then gradual rollout. will post PR link when draft is ready.
Declan Wu: checklist: unit tests, node+py parity, sample-app docs, telemetry, feature flag, PR review. no objections from me.
Priya Menon: LGTM. :shipit:
Omar Farouk: will add fuzz tests for random chunk boundaries.
Hana Mori: will coordinate release notes for onboarding so new users know streaming+json mode caveats.
